get.description: Alerts for the guard console, newest first. `acknowledged=false` = still open.

post.description: Mark an alert as seen. Safe to call twice.

get.description: Vehicles on the premises right now: the guard console's counter (staff).

Busiest hours, visit durations, overstay rate, frequent visitors and what's inside
right now. Hours and days are in IST.
Residents: requests for their flats (`status=pending` for the inbox). Staff: all.

post.description:
Approve or deny a visitor for your flat. Repeating the same answer is fine (200);
changing it after deciding, or answering after the timeout, is a 409.

get.description: Every admin change, newest first. Read-only.

post.description:
Log in with email (in the `username` field) and password.

Sent as a form (OAuth2 password flow), which is what the **Authorize** button in
`/docs` uses.
Revoke a refresh token. The short-lived access token simply expires.
Swap a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works only once.

get.description:
Public. In demo mode: the demo accounts and their shared password, for the landing
page's one-click logins. Otherwise `enabled: false` and nothing else.

post.description:
Admin, demo mode only (404 otherwise): wipe all data and seed it again, with two
weeks of fresh history. Everyone is signed out.
Registers a camera and returns its API key. **The key is shown only once.**

get.description: For cameras: check that an API key works. Send it in the `X-Device-Key` header.

delete.description: Only works for a device that never sent an event (otherwise 409; deactivate it).

post.description: Issues a new API key; the old key stops working immediately.

get.description: "Call the resident" tasks for visits 60+ minutes over their limit (`status=open`).

post.description: Record what happened. `vehicle_left` also closes the visit.

parameters.name: q

schema.title: Q

delete.description: Only works for a flat with no residents, vehicles or history (otherwise 409).

post.description:
For cameras (send the device key in `X-Device-Key`): report one plate read.

Send it as `multipart/form-data`. Retrying the same read is safe: you get the original
event back with `status: duplicate`.

get.description: Reads that need a guard: unsure, unreadable or ambiguous. Newest first.

post.description:
Resolve a review item. `correct` re-runs matching with the given plate (resident
entry/exit, visitor entry/exit, watchlist) and saves it as labelled OCR data.

get.description: The plate snapshot image of an event.

delete.description: Only works for a gate without devices (otherwise 409; deactivate it instead).
Deactivates the guard (their logins stop at once); the record is kept for history.

get.description: Residents: their flats' passes. Staff: all. `active=true`: usable right now.

post.description:
Pre-approve a guest by plate (the camera lets them in) and/or with a one-time code
(shown only in this response).
The guard types the code a guest shows: the visit is created and marked inside.

get.description: The logged-in user, with their flats if they are a resident.
The log of emails and Telegram messages (newest first), for checking delivery.
What the nightly reconciliation found (`resolved=false` for open items).

post.description: Creates the resident's login and links them to the flat.

delete.description: Removes the person from the flat; deactivates their login if no flats remain.

get.description: Visit time limits per category and the approval timeout.

patch.description: Change limits (admin). Applies to visits that enter from now on. Audited.

post.description: Open `link` on your phone (or send `/start <code>` to the bot) within 10 minutes.

post.description:
The guard registers a visitor. The flat's residents are asked to approve (web push +
Telegram); after `approval_timeout_seconds` the guard decides with `/decision`.

Pass `gate_event_id` (the unknown entry read) and the car is admitted the moment a
resident approves.
The guard approves or denies after the residents' time ran out (409 before that).
Mark an approved visitor as inside by hand (walk-in, or the camera missed it).
Mark a visitor as gone by hand.

get.description: Liveness check: answers as long as the process is running.
